note: NIAID's PathogenAR influenza teaching model, retaining its existing cutaway and source colors for hemagglutinin, neuraminidase and internal components. This is a scientific illustration, not a measured virion reconstruction. The complete model's longest source span is displayed at the cube root of the listed representative volume (an equivalent-volume span). The cutaway does not enclose that volume; spike extent, membrane boundary and strain-dependent particle volume are not measured here.

operations: Make implicit default material explicit; retain original vertex colors
Deduplicate, weld, simplify with target ratio 0.24 and relative error 0.01, prune

volume_calibration.method: Longest native source span normalized to 1, so displayed span is V^(1/3). Equivalent-span illustration only; no enclosed, material or capacity volume measured.
